description: Transformadores PCB is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agencia de Protección Ambiental. Ubicación geográfica y potencia de los transformadores, el tipo de material aislante que utilizan y las concentraciones de PCBs de cada uno. Cuenta con más de 7 mil puntos georeferenciados que coinciden con emplazamientos con PCBs. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia de Protección Ambiental. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
